steps: Deployed the program to devnet (upgrade authority is the lab wallet)
Upgraded the program with the lab initialize_registry patch

evidence.functional_evidence: initialize_registry, register_agent, update_state (Active), execute_task (tasks_completed=1, verified=true) and deactivate_agent all landed and were read back; AgentNotActive and AgentDeactivated were rejected as expected.
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; the same instructions were sent with the lab wallet through the IDL client in tests/devnet/agentx.mjs.

limitations: claim_reward was not exercised: it needs an AGX token vault signed by the registry PDA. initialize_registry is a Sol.College lab patch, not present upstream.
